source.license_note: Real upstream badger optimization PR #1173; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up concurrent skiplist writes by removing contention on the global math/rand mutex used when picking a node's random height, without changing behavior.
task.instructions: Optimize the skl package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkWrite measures concurrent Put throughput; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: randomHeight() calls the global math/rand source (rand.Uint32), whose internal mutex serializes every concurrent skiplist Put, limiting parallel write throughput.

ops_fault.description: Concurrent skiplist writes contend on the global math/rand lock taken inside randomHeight() in skl/skl.go, serializing Put across goroutines.
repair_keywords: replace global rand with local source

visible_context.issue_text: Skiplist write throughput does not scale with goroutines because every Put picks a random node height using the shared math/rand source, which serializes callers on its internal lock.
error_logs: concurrency profile shows contention on math/rand's global lock inside skl.randomHeight on the Put path
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization; concurrency diagnosis injected as upstream context.
